title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S. | TechCrunch
summary: As part of a planned data center in Pecos County, Texas, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States, according to The New York Times .
